reason: Article 17 requires providers to establish a quality management system that includes an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of management and staff. This framework could be used to implement segregation of duties, which is a key part of the control objective. However, the provision does not explicitly mandate the segregation of specific privileges (admin, model, security configuration) or the use of PAM, approval, four-eyes checks, or admin logs.
